Unzip anywhere and run `DndBattlemapGenerator.exe` — there is no installer and
nothing is written outside the folder. Windows SmartScreen will object because
the binary is unsigned: **More info → Run anyway**.

ComfyUI with Ideogram 4 is needed to paint a map, and Ollama to have a scene
planned for you. Neither is needed to draw a layout by hand or to export it to
Dungeondraft. Setup is in `docs/Manual.pdf`, chapter 2.

The asset index for the Dungeondraft export is built on your own machine from
the packs you own — the release ships an empty `data/` folder, not somebody
else's library.
